name: manual_c1b94c
claim: For a coordinated lockstep change, pin exact peer commit SHAs and contract, fixture, policy and environment digests before testing; update both repositories with implementation, tests, active references and handoff; treat candidate overlays as test-only; and promote a production dependency pin only after upstream merge and downstream full-suite plus oracle revalidation.

decisions.notes: The Loop/Graph PT to Orama and Core to Oramasys work showed that a passing candidate overlay and a published branch do not prove a production pin is safe. Recording exact artifacts, paired evidence and the promotion gate prevents stale branch references, accidental cross-regime dependencies and premature production pin updates.
